question: Which official body handles the training rules and licenses for midwives in Nigeria?

options.B: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
options.D: National Association of Nigeria Nurses and Midwives

explanation: The NMCN is the official body set up by law to manage nursing and midwifery education and practice across Nigeria. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h1)

question: Why is self-regulation important for the midwifery profession?

options.A: It replaces the need for government health policies.
options.B: It allows midwives to set their own salaries without negotiation.
options.C: It ensures that midwives never face disciplinary actions.
options.D: It maintains high standards of safe, ethical, and competent care.

explanation: Professional governance helps the profession oversee its members so that the public receives safe and quality maternal care. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h1)

question: What does NANNM stand for in the Nigerian healthcare system?

options.A: National Association of Nigeria Nurses and Midwives
options.B: Nigerian Association of National Nurses and Midwives
options.C: Nursing Association of Nigeria National Midwives
options.D: National Alliance of Nigerian Nurses and Medicine

explanation: NANNM serves as the recognized professional body and trade union for both nurses and midwives in Nigeria. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h2)

question: Which level is the highest decision-making group inside NANNM?
explanation: The National Executive Council directs the policies, major decisions, and national negotiations of the association. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h2)

question: Why does NANNM work as both a professional group and a trade union?

options.A: To provide free medical treatment to all pregnant women in Nigeria.
options.B: To handle hospital management and patient admissions directly.
options.C: To replace the regulatory duties of the Nursing and Midwifery Council.
options.D: To protect professional standards while also fighting for workers' rights and better pay.

explanation: This dual role lets NANNM uphold clinical ethics while also negotiating welfare, salaries, and safety for practitioners. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h3)

question: Midwives at a rural clinic have not received their hazard allowances for six months. Which group should they turn to for help?

options.C: National Association of Nigeria Nurses and Midwives
options.D: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: As the registered trade union, NANNM deals with workers' welfare issues, salary disputes, and unpaid allowances. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h3)

question: Which of these is NOT a duty of NANNM?

options.A: Protecting against unjust treatment and hostile work environments
options.B: Pushing back against unsafe workloads and staff shortages
options.C: Setting the official passing score for professional board exams
options.D: Providing legal support during workplace disputes

explanation: Setting board exam pass marks is the job of the Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria, not NANNM. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h4)

question: How does protecting the working conditions of midwives help the public?

options.A: It guarantees that midwives will never go on strike.
options.B: It removes the need for hospitals to employ doctors.
options.C: Well-supported and safe midwives are better equipped to provide quality care to mothers and babies.
options.D: It allows midwives to increase consultation fees for patients.

explanation: When practitioners are protected from extreme stress and poor conditions, clinical errors decrease and maternal-child health improves. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h4)

question: What is the main goal of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) programs for midwives?

options.A: To recruit international nurses into Nigerian hospitals
options.B: To determine the retirement age of healthcare workers
options.C: To update clinical skills and knowledge with current evidence-based practices
options.D: To replace initial basic nursing and midwifery training schools

explanation: CPD makes sure practicing midwives stay updated with new medical knowledge and changing obstetric guidelines. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h5)

question: How do professional specialty groups fit into the structure of NANNM?

options.A: They focus on specific clinical areas like maternal or pediatric care while remaining under the NANNM umbrella.
options.B: They function as international bodies that regulate global nursing licenses.
options.C: They operate as independent political parties separate from the health sector.
options.D: They manage hospital finances and drug procurement independently.

explanation: Specialty groups let members with shared clinical interests advance specific areas of practice while staying united. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h5)

question: Which international group focuses on global standards and advocacy for midwives everywhere?
explanation: The ICM is the global professional organization that strengthens midwifery associations and sets international practice standards. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h6)

question: Why does NANNM talk with lawmakers at the National Assembly about new health bills?

options.A: To ensure that laws passed support safe clinical practice and protect the welfare of health workers
options.B: To stop doctors from practicing medicine in government hospitals
options.C: To secure direct appointment of nurses into political legislative seats
options.D: To allow midwives to bypass the Nursing and Midwifery Council entirely

explanation: Legislative advocacy ensures that national laws promote quality healthcare delivery and protect the rights of workers. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h6)

question: What is the workforce challenge often called Japa that affects Nigerian healthcare?

options.A: Mass migration of skilled practitioners abroad for better opportunities
options.B: Mandatory retirement of all nurses under the age of forty
options.C: A total ban on training new midwives in government schools
options.D: The complete replacement of midwives by artificial intelligence

explanation: The heavy movement of healthcare workers seeking greener pastures abroad has reduced the local Nigerian health workforce. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h7)

question: How does the departure of experienced midwives affect the staff left behind in local clinics?

options.A: It increases workloads, leading to exhaustion, burnout, and heightened stress.
options.B: It automatically increases the salaries of those who stay behind.
options.C: It eliminates the need for any continuing education programs.
options.D: It reduces the number of pregnant women visiting primary health centers.

explanation: When colleagues leave without immediate replacements, remaining staff take on extra shifts and duties, causing severe fatigue. [learn more](BMP322_U2_T2#BMP322_U2_T2_h7)
